mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.images, s.price, s.score, s.location, s.view_count, s.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, s.status, s.recommend_level, s.create_time FROM scenic s LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.images, s.price, s.score, s.location, s.view_count, s.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, s.status, s.recommend_level, s.create_time, st.name AS tag_name, uc.id AS comment_id, uc.user_id, uc.target_id AS scenic_id, uc.content AS comment_content, uc.create_time AS comment_create_time, u.username, u.avatar FROM scenic s LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN scenic_tag_relation str ON s.id = str.scenic_id LEFT JOIN scenic_tag st ON str.tag_id = st.id LEFT JOIN user_comment uc ON s.id = uc.target_id AND uc.is_audit = 1 LEFT JOIN user u ON uc.user_id = u.id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.images, s.price, s.score, s.location, s.view_count, s.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, s.status, s.recommend_level, s.create_time FROM scenic s LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.name}, '%')
AND s.category_id = #{query.categoryId}
AND s.id IN ( SELECT scenic_id FROM scenic_tag_relation WHERE tag_id = #{query.tagId} )
AND s.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.location}, '%')
AND s.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY s.view_count DESC, s.create_time DESC

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.images, s.price, s.score, s.location, s.view_count, s.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, s.status, s.recommend_level, s.create_time FROM scenic s LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id INNER JOIN scenic_tag_relation str ON s.id = str.scenic_id WHERE str.tag_id = #{tagId} ORDER BY s.view_count DESC

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.images, s.price, s.score, s.location, s.view_count, s.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, s.status, s.recommend_level, s.create_time FROM scenic s LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE s.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY s.view_count DESC

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.images, s.price, s.score, s.location, s.view_count, s.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, s.status, s.recommend_level, s.create_time FROM scenic s LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.view_count DESC, s.score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.images, s.price, s.score, s.location, s.view_count, s.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, s.status, s.recommend_level, s.create_time FROM scenic s LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
